Converse pulls sneaker ad after accusations of racist imagery

American footwear brand Converse has apologized and removed a sneaker advertisement after critics stated it contained racist imagery, specifically evoking Ku Klux Klan visuals. The company acknowledged the image was "deeply upsetting."
